evidence.method: First-person actual-pixel inspection of exactly five existing PNG tiles, each opened once with functions.view_image detail=original.
evidence.captureAuthorization: Explicitly authorized isolated headless offline evidence at 1440x960 and 390x844.
evidence.limitation: Authorized isolated headless offline display evidence, not formal headed product acceptance. Verdict covers only reviewBatches[2].targets, not other batches, earlier mobile text, desktop, Chinese surfaces, live behavior, or the complete card.
evidence.originalBindings: Original screenshot paths and hashes are retained from the source manifest only; original screenshots were not opened or independently hashed.
evidence.extractionBoundaryPolicy: These are contiguous full-resolution screenshot extracts. A line crossing a tile boundary is not itself product clipping. Text tile 4 ends at source y=5500 and text tile 5 begins there; their split glyph fragments were inspected in the two assigned opens.
